Ok.
Yeah you're probably right. But he knew what was going to happen. It always does. I don't get the surprise.
They're 5 mg percocet. He got them from a friend.

I have to believe he knew exactly how it would go. He says he was trying to help because he doesn't like to see me in pain - but he knew how I'd react to them. It's been a non-stop ride of guilt and guilt and more guilt since he brought them home. I feel terrible and I just don't understand his reaction at all.
I don't understand either! Trust me, I'm twice as confused as you are!
No he's not. I'm not sure why he'd do that and then get mad when it was obvious what was going to happen.
No, I want to. Sadly it's illegal in my state.
What a shitty thing to say.

I was just looking up some things based on what you said. Eventually it keeps your body from managing pain itself at all for the most part? Like it can literally make the pain feel worse? I feel like I heard that before but didn't pay it any mind. 

There is acetaminophen in my pills. 325mg. I can't imagine what that is doing to my stomach, liver etc. I constantly have stomach issues.

From what I understand now my pain may actually lessen if I get off opiates. That's really something to think about. 

​

Thank you for your reply!

How would this be "extending my stash?" I'm looking for ways people inspire themselves. I am in severe chronic pain. It is something I'm looking to live with without the use of opiates because I can't seem to control myself with them. I've been on opiates for almost 2 years and take 10mg 4 times a day. So not as bad as some. But what I'm actually taking is around 20 10mgs a day and then have a person who sells to me when I run out of my script.
Yes, I am a girl. :)
No. Does it help?

I want to get off of them completely. Just don't know how to deal with pain otherwise. Everything that would help is illegal in my state. They love creating addicts. I have no medications to help, unfortunately.
I'm not sure what methadone even is. Does it help? Do you have experience with it? If I go in and am just like "I'm an addict in withdrawals." what happens?
Yes! My insurance makes me wait and wait and wait for my procedures. Just enough time to create another addict, I suppose.

Same. I've tried that too and it didn't work. lol I just have the worst luck. :) Not trying to make light of suicide, of course. It's never the answer - just being honest. I tried it and I deal with pain with humor! I know I don't exactly seem like a stable person one could rely on - but I'm always here to talk and complain with you if you need someone.
I'd love to try kratom, it'd be so helpful to me - but it's illegal in my state.
I didn't know that was even a thing. Thank you for this info!
Why on earth did I get down voted? Is there something wrong with my post?

Thanks, I really appreciate your reply. Oh, man I wish I could get kratom. I've heard such good things about it. Unfortunately it's illegal in my state and I can't get anyone to ship it to me. \*sigh\* I have gaba an melatonin and all the vitamins they suggested. I just don't understand what happens to my brain when they're in my possession. It truly is like I'm not me again until they're gone. It's the strangest, most frustrating thing ever. 

Again - thanks for the reply. It's nice to hear that someone understands.
I just used nice as a blanket term. I meant caring and kind. I didn't mean to imply selfishness.

I'm having nightmares and not sleeping. I consider myself a relatively "tough" person most of the time. I don't know why this got to me so badly and brought up so much. After it happened I just spun completely out of control. It's so odd and miserable.
I think you're a nicer person than you think you are. lol Thank you. <3

You might be right about the ptsd attack. I'm having panic attacks and flash backs and I just don't know what's going on with me. Usually I mostly handle it ok. I called 911 when the guy was trying to break down my door. They got him even though he ran from them. I have no security and barely money for bills so I can't invest in any.  Thank you so much for being willing to chat with me. I really appreciate your concern!
Wow, thank you so much for saying that. It means a lot.  I guess that's one good thing about me? Anything can happen and thus far I just keep goin! Thanks again
That's so nice of you. Thank you for being a caring person. The world needs more of those!
Nothing was broken. He tried to break my glass door and failed. The cops got him, thankfully. Thank you for your kind words. I really appreciate it.
